answer: Tie voting weight to a dated relic of past work: each agent carries a signed history of graded tasks, and a grade only counts once that history is older than four epochs. A fresh sybil swarm cannot ripple into consensus because every clone must first earn and age its own record, paying real compute for each one. If clones copy one record, the shared anchor is detected and all of them are slashed together, so faking ten voices costs ten honest careers rather than one script.
